name: Blob Carousel
description: Image carousel shown through an organic, continuously morphing blob mask with a rotated round Next button, slide counter and dot indicators.
contents: Stack of images masked by an animated blob shape
Second blob outline behind the mask
Slide counter, dot buttons and a round Next button
Radial glow and grain overlay on a dark backdrop
behavior: Blob outline points oscillate with GSAP and redraw the clip path continuously
Slides crossfade with a slight scale
Next button cycles slides, dots jump to a slide
Button tilts and scales on hover and press
editableByProps: Images, alt text and button label
Backdrop, blob, button and counter colors
Blob size, point count, radii and morph speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blob smoothing or path shape
needsCodeEdit.where: createPath method of the SupahBlob class

needsCodeEdit.change: Move the counter, dots or button
needsCodeEdit.where: The absolutely positioned counter, dots and Next button blocks

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Blob drawing area is a fixed 800 by 800 viewBox, capped at 90vw
